shared: A lemming herd marching in file, where your front unit and the order deaths come in decide fights.
differ: What it runs on: an off-board token stockpile, deaths feeding one leader, or only the front's text.

takes.label: The Kit stockpile
takes.line: Spare Kits pile up in an off-board Burrow; each turn you hoard them as fight HP or cash them into stats (Ferrywife).
takes.look_if: a herd that grows every turn and a keep-or-spend choice.

takes.label: Deaths feed the leader
takes.line: Fallen Lemmings hand stats to whoever leads, so one leader grows huge; you can kill it to pass them on.
takes.look_if: simple death-and-buff play that builds one huge leader.

takes.label: Only the front speaks
takes.line: Only your front Lemming's text works; the rest stay silent until those ahead fall, so slot order sets who acts when.
takes.look_if: a puzzle where line order decides which card gets to act.
